data.text: Thanks, Luke. I’m willing to choose 12 tons under that split if everyone agrees before we fish. My family has depended on this lake for generations, and leaving 50 tons protects next month’s catch and our village’s livelihood. I’d support rotating the shares so each of us gets two months at 12 tons, two at 10, and one at 6 over five months. John, does this month’s proposal work for you?
